description: This file declares the SharedMemoryBuffer class and its factory, which manage shared memory buffers for media playback and web audio within the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and data structures related to shared memory management.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating shared memory buffer instances.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Implementation of shared memory buffer management for media playback and web audio.

methods.name: createSharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a shared memory buffer for specified number of playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shared memory buffer with specified partitions.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Maps a specific media playback partition into memory.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Unmaps a specific media playback partition from memory.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears data in a specified partition.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the data offset for a specific partition.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum data length for a specific partition.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the data buffer for a specific partition.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the shared memory buffer.
